BP5.1.sentence: `workbench.desktop.main.ts` imports `workbench.common.main.js` and then adds the desktop-only pieces: `electron-browser/desktop.main` and `desktop.contribution`, the native text file service...

BP5.2.sentence: `workbench.web.main.ts` (with `workbench.web.main.internal.ts`) imports the same common entry, then the web-specific services (`browser/web.main.ts`, `web.factory.ts`, `web.api.ts`).

BP5.4.sentence: Each platform provides its own implementation of a service interface. For example, the desktop build registers the native text file service. Callers depend only on the interface.

BP5.6.sentence: If a contribution isn't imported by `common`, `desktop` or `web`, it never ships.

BP5.4.sentence: Both builds register the same service interfaces, such as text files and extensions. Each one registers a different implementation.
